newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S 20 KMS WALK WORLD CHAMPION GARCIA.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF MEN'S 20 KMS WALK WORLD CHAMPION GARCIA.

text.p: Profile of Daniel Garcia, who won the world men's 20 kms walk title on Saturday.
Winner of the 1993 World Cup, Garcia was third at the world championships that year in Stuttgart when he was disqualified close to the finish.
He was disqualified again two years later in Gothenburg.
In last year's Olympics, he finished a disappointing 19th in the 20 kms and ninth in the 50 kms.
